name: Griesner Alm
beschreibung:
Nestled at the head of the romantic Kaiserbachtal valley near Kirchdorf in Tirol, Griesner Alm is an alpine paradise for climbers and nature enthusiasts. Cosy guestrooms and hearty mountain dining provide true comfort.

Dramatic rock faces, alpine hiking trails, and the surrounding Kitzbuehel Alps are right outside.
kurzbeschreibung: Alpengasthof Griesner Alm in the Kaiserbachtal valley offers rustic mountain serenity by the Wilder Kaiser peaks.
